title: SdkConfig
description: Configuration object passed to `SdkClient::init()`. Every field except `gateway_url` and `sdk_key` has a default; SDKs MAY accept the entire config as optional except for those two.

gateway_url.description: Base URL of the stitchd-gateway. Both REST and gRPC are served from the same host; the SDK appends the gRPC port internally (see `gateway_grpc_port`).

sdk_key.description: SDK key scoped to a single (project, environment). Validated by the gateway on every request.

gateway_grpc_port.description: Port the gateway's tonic gRPC server listens on (for SyncDefinitions).

definition_poll_interval_ms.description: How often the background task polls SyncDefinitions. Milliseconds.

list_segment_refresh_interval_ms.description: How often the LRU refresh task fetches up-to-date membership for all resident LRU entries. Milliseconds.

lru_max_entries.description: Capacity of the list-segment membership LRU, keyed on (context_type, context_key).

event_flush_interval_ms.description: How often the event flush task drains the buffer to the gateway. Milliseconds.

event_batch_size.description: Maximum events per flush. Reaching this size triggers an immediate flush regardless of `event_flush_interval_ms`.

event_buffer_capacity.description: Maximum events buffered between flushes. When full, the oldest event is dropped (back-pressure on `evaluate()` is NOT acceptable).

request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for ALL gateway HTTP/gRPC calls (definition sync, LRU fetch, event flush).
